data.name: LinkedIn: Create Organization Post
data.description: Create a text post on LinkedIn on behalf of an organization.
data.instructions:
Create a text post on LinkedIn on behalf of an organization.

Publish content to an organization's LinkedIn page. The post will be publicly visible.

**Inputs:**
- {organization_id}: The LinkedIn organization ID
- {content}: The text content of the post

**Output:** {result} contains the created post confirmation.
